ecoplug_select.title: Select ecoPlug
ecoplug_select.description: Select the plugs to add. You can then switch them on or off and view their power and cumulative active energy.

ecomain_cloud_confirm.title: Confirm Device
ecomain_cloud_confirm.description:
Serial number: {ecomain_serial}

Confirm this ecoMain and select any ecoSub devices to add with it. If there are none, continue without selecting any.

measurement_types.title: Measurement Types
measurement_types.description: Select the measurements you want to view. Choose at least one type.

extra_formula.title: Add Formula Entity
extra_formula.description: Enter an entity name and choose the result type and unit. Select “Number (no unit)” if no unit is needed.

extra_formula_sources.title: Select Source Entities
extra_formula_sources.description: Select the source entities to use in the formula. You can select multiple entities; at least one is required.

extra_formula_expression.title: Expression
extra_formula_expression.description:
Variables:
{variables}

- Supports +, -, *, /, parentheses, abs, min, max and round.
- Examples: `max(a-b,0)`, `(a+b)/2`.
- Check that the calculated result uses the unit of the selected result type.

extra_formula_edit.title: Edit Formula Entity
extra_formula_edit.description: Select the formula entity to edit. You will need to enter the expression again. To change the result type, create a new formula entity.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate cloud account
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again using the same cloud account to restore access.
